name: @steadybrew/postgresjs
description: PostgreSQL client for Node.js and Deno, independently maintained by Steady Brew

scripts.build: npm run build:cjs && npm run build:deno && npm run build:cf
scripts.test: npm run test:startup && npm run test:esm && npm run test:cjs && npm run test:deno
scripts.test:cjs: npm run build:cjs && node tests-startup/run.js --integration --cjs && cd cjs/tests && node index.js && cd ../../
scripts.test:deno: npm run test:deno-socket && npm run build:deno && cd deno/tests && deno run --no-lock --allow-all --unsafely-ignore-certificate-errors index.js && cd ../../
scripts.lint: eslint src && eslint tests && eslint tests-startup --ext .js,.mjs

author: Rasmus Porsager <rasmus@porsager.com> (https://www.porsager.com)
